overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Paseo Verde Little League team of Henderson, Nevada, for winning the United States Championship at the 2026 Little League World Series. It recounts the team's undefeated run through the state and regional tournaments and its wins in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, including the championship game against a team from Hamilton, Ohio. It commends the players, coaches, families and volunteers. It does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on September 23, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution honors young athletes and the community volunteers behind them for an outstanding achievement on a national stage.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
